expected_form.resumen: Online store down from a nearly full disk on the production web server; site restored after clearing logs and tuning memory, with about three hours of impact during sales hours.
expected_form.que_paso: Monitoring flagged around five forty in the morning that the site was not responding; on arrival the production web server was up but stuck, with the disk nearly full; old logs were cleared, memory was tuned and the site came back. The payments API queued up while the site was down and tested fine after a trial purchase.

timeline.evento: Technician arrival at the server room
Site responding again after cleanup and tuning

action_items: Ask the provider for more disk on the web server
Set up monitoring alerts by SMS, not just email

user_utterances.text: Alright, I'm wrapped up at Uniformes Delta, heading out... it was the online store going down this morning... log the incident report for me before I forget it all.

Well, monitoring flagged at around five forty in the morning that the site wasn't responding... when I got there, the web server was up but stuck, with the disk nearly full... I cleaned out the old logs, tuned the memory, and it came back.
The outage was flagged by monitoring at five forty... that's the first one.
That's it... I got to the server room at seven thirty... and at eight forty-five the site was responding again.
Well, the one that went down was the production web server... and the staging one never even noticed, it stayed up all night.
Production!... the production one is the one that went down, staging stayed up, that's why I say it never even noticed.
That's it, production... and the payments API also queued up, because payments weren't going through even when the site came back up... I already tested it with a trial purchase and it's fine.
Yes, that one... the payments one.
Put down... medium, I guess, since it's working again in the end.

No, it's high, not medium... three hours down during sales hours, that's high... and note down two follow-ups: ask the provider for more disk on the web server, and have monitoring alert by SMS, not just email.
Yes, high... that's how it should be, send it.
